source_semantics.summary: The authoritative AIMWWeb POST /setup is a first-run anonymous setup mutation. It consumes setup form values, invokes DatabaseSetupService.ApplyAsync, redirects to / on success, and renders setup HTML with HTTP 400 on failure.
source_semantics.antiforgery: the source explicitly disables antiforgery on this endpoint

laravel_adaptation.success: redirect to / after durable tenant, owner identity, membership, role, and permission bootstrap
laravel_adaptation.failure: HTTP 400 setup HTML with bounded operator-safe text while exception detail remains server-side
laravel_adaptation.database_credentials: deployment-owned; anonymous setup requests do not receive or persist database/provider credentials
laravel_adaptation.csrf: retained as an intentional security strengthening; the setup Blade form emits @csrf
laravel_adaptation.tenant_boundary: anonymous pre-tenant route with no tenant route parameter or tenant.context middleware; TenantContext is activated only around tenant-scoped persistence and forgotten afterwards

acceptance.operation_link: AIMW-CONT-475267F150 is pinned in focused acceptance and this evidence file
acceptance.success_criteria: fresh setup creates exactly one owner identity and tenant RBAC bootstrap and redirects to /
acceptance.failure_criteria: partial identity state or invalid input cannot claim or mutate installation state; sensitive values are not rendered

security.authentication: pre-authentication first-run boundary; no auth middleware is required
security.tenant_isolation: no tenant selector or tenant route parameter is accepted by POST /setup
security.credential_handling: database/provider credentials are deployment-owned and absent from the public setup form
security.csrf: Laravel deliberately strengthens the source contract by retaining web CSRF protection
security.password_handling: owner password is hashed and never reflected into failure output
security.partial_state: existing identity state fails closed instead of being claimed by a new anonymous setup request
